metricDefinitions.blocked_findings: Count all detected order, item, delivery, credit, and VBUV missing-field findings; return 0 when every exact source is complete and no finding exists.

acceptance.businessStatusDefinition: Return normal when blocked_findings is 0 and blocked when it is positive. Missing code text keeps the raw blocked business conclusion but makes the technical run inconclusive; other blocking evidence gaps return capability_blocked.

summary.en: The original three-stage acceptance remains passed; the incremental live replay confirms that block, credit, and incompletion codes retain their raw values and resolve authoritative SAP texts.
